Multiple outlets report it, including ARY News/AFP, which describes her as South African judge Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, recognized for promoting peace and international law. The Nobel Committee chair, Jørgen Watne Frydnes, said the committee's reasoning centered on how conflict resolution depends on the international rule of law (the South Africa-born Pillay, 85 years old). Khaleej Times quotes the award citation as recognizing her "efforts to promote peace and international law" (The Nobel Prize was awarded to Pillay for her "efforts to promote peace and international law.").

The committee received 287 candidates that were nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize this year, 208 are individuals and 79 are organisations.

Last year's laureate was María Corina Machado, the Venezuelan opposition leader (Last year's winner was María Corina Machado, Venezuela's opposition leader.).

Committee chair Jørgen Watne Frydnes said resolving conflicts depends on the international rule of law.

The committee received 287 nominations this year: 208 individuals and 79 organisations. Last year's laureate was María Corina Machado of Venezuela.
